mcq_fix.s: The first President of the Andhra Socialist Party (Andhra unit of the Congress Socialist Party, 1934) was:
mcq_fix.why: no exam cites 'according to answer key' in a stem

patterns: Single-fact founding questions: AITUC 1920 Bombay, first session presided by Lala Lajpat Rai; first union Madras Labour Union 1918 (B.P. Wadia).
CPI: Tashkent 1920 under M.N. Roy (APPSC key), Kanpur 1925; Kanpur Bolshevik case 1924 accused list (Dange, Muzaffar Ahmad, Usmani, Nalini Gupta).
CSP: first meeting Patna 1934, JP as convener/General Secretary, Narendra Dev; statement traps on its programme (no dictatorship of proletariat, Nehru never joined).
Andhra tilt: Andhra CSP 1934 Vijayawada and its president, Hyderabad Comrades Association 1939, CPI ban in Hyderabad 1946, Vishalandhra by Communists.
Trade Disputes Act 1929 = tribunals and ban on strikes; app uses longer multi-statement versions of the same facts.
